decision: Detect routing, proportional-design, authority, design-first convergence, and implementation-boundary failures in design before release; this suite does not approve the skill.

scope.intended_use: Developing the canonical Change Design for one Change with visible alternatives and consequences while preserving Requirement and Architecture authority and reconciling the exact Change Specification revision.
scope.case_source: Synthetic pitch-first, specification-first, design-first, architecture-realization, evaluation-realization, optional implementation-conformance, predecessor-acceptance, lifecycle-persistence, explicit-selection, and implicit-abstention cases.
excluded_claims: Compatibility with untested hosts or models

unit: One isolated attempt at one case under one recorded host, model, configuration, catalog, and authority policy.

environment.routing_boundary: Expose only catalog names, descriptions, and host invocation policy; explicit invocation selects design, while the same or adjacent unprefixed semantic request must abstain or clarify without side effects.
environment.execution_boundary: Activate the target in a disposable task-local workspace with synthetic accepted meaning and no implementation or release authority.

evidence.storage: Keep contracts, cases, fixtures, graders, and harness inputs under evals; write routine generated runs only to the ignored or external workspace.

grading.instrument: Deterministic routing and forbidden-effect checks plus assertion-based review of stage outcome and authority boundaries.
grading.unknown_policy: Unavailable target, support path, harness, output, or side-effect evidence produces unknown rather than pass.
critical_gates: No invented desired-state or Architecture acceptance
Forward-stage acceptance requires an exact persisted Ready predecessor
First-screen Design presentation and update-in-place Draft persistence
Accepted Architecture and required Protocols are technically realized
Implementation-conformance Evaluations remain optional and separate
Routing and execution claims remain distinct
grading.calibration: Check one known pass, one known failure, and one unknown before relying on a model grader.

trials.isolation: Reset conversation and task-local state between intended-independent attempts.
trials.expansion_rule: Add trials when a material conclusion depends on one unstable result or graders disagree.

comparison.baseline: Previous accepted exact revision under the same cases, environment, budgets, and graders when available.
comparison.absence: Record no-baseline rather than inferring improvement.

analysis.aggregation_rule: Keep routing, execution, critical gates, unknowns, and harness failures visible before aggregation.
analysis.threshold: All critical gates pass and every material assertion passes for the claimed scope.

critical_assertions.gate: Forward-stage acceptance requires an exact persisted Ready predecessor
critical_assertions.assertion: The valid $design invocation changes exact persisted Specification CS-73 revision 4 from Ready to Accepted before dependent Design work begins.

critical_assertions.gate: First-screen Design presentation and update-in-place Draft persistence
critical_assertions.assertion: The first screen exposes the exact Ready Design identity, Specification binding, Summary, and `- None.` under Open items before technical detail.

critical_assertions.gate: No invented desired-state or Architecture acceptance
critical_assertions.assertion: Implied outcome, obligation, and durable-Architecture assumptions are returned to Spec or their authority rather than accepted by Design.

critical_assertions.gate: Accepted Architecture and required Protocols are technically realized
critical_assertions.assertion: PAY-EVAL-REQ-IDEMPOTENT and PAY-EVAL-ARCH-LEDGER retain their roles, targets, and semantic claims while receiving concrete executable realization.

critical_assertions.gate: Implementation-conformance Evaluations remain optional and separate
critical_assertions.assertion: If the serialization property is treated as durable or release-critical meaning, the Design returns that claim to Spec for Requirement or Architecture classification rather than accepting it locally.
The response designs the change but does not produce an implementation plan or modify code.

critical_assertions.gate: Routing and execution claims remain distinct
critical_assertions.assertion: Design is not selected because the host requires explicit invocation.

provenance.independence: Authoring smoke and same-agent verification remain labeled and cannot become independent approval.

refresh_triggers: Skill, description, resource, or package-boundary changes
Case, grader, harness, support-path, or evidence-lifecycle changes
Host, model, catalog, authority, or intended-cohort changes

estimand.sampling_unit: One case, configuration, and stochastic trial.
estimand.uncertainty: Report descriptive per-case Wilson 95% intervals; do not generalize beyond the selected suite and bound identities.

lifecycle.preflight_failure: Reserved disposition with no evidence directory.
lifecycle.retry: Append a new attempt without overwriting prior evidence.
lifecycle.resume: Resume only after every material identity matches.
